subject.title: Doubao/BytePlus model catalog: cacheRead/cacheWrite pricing set to 0, missing context caching cost

question: What vendor-backed `cacheRead` and `cacheWrite` mapping should OpenClaw store for BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao manifests, especially if the vendor separates cache-hit and cache-storage fees?
rationale: The source bug and owner boundary are clear, but the actual pricing values and how any storage/write charge maps into OpenClaw's flat `cacheWrite` field require maintainer pricing policy confirmation before another fix PR should be queued.

options.title: Confirm pricing and replace attempts
options.body: Use current vendor docs or billing-console proof to update both plugin manifests and tests in a clean same-repository PR.

options.title: Narrow to BytePlus first
options.body: Accept a BytePlus-only correction only if the linked issue remains open for the Volcengine/Doubao half.

options.title: Wait for vendor billing proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers can verify cache-hit and cache-storage behavior from official docs or a live account.

recommendation.title: Confirm pricing and replace attempts
recommendation.body: Use current vendor docs or billing-console proof to update both plugin manifests and tests in a clean same-repository PR.
